en.t: In Bai Juyi's poem on parting from Yuan Weizhi, he writes:

units.source_text: 往事渺茫都似梦，旧游零落半归泉。

en.t: The past has grown distant and hazy, all of it like a dream; old companions from former days have scattered, and half have returned to the grave.

units.source_text: 醉悲洒泪春杯里，吟苦支颐晓烛前。”

en.t: Drunk with sorrow, I shed tears into the spring wine cup; suffering as I chant, I prop my chin before the dawn candle.
